Mowing is a garden seen from straight above on a summer afternoon. Eggy is mowing the lawn on a ride-on mower, and he does it all himself: the mower's sensor sees a little way ahead, it steers round the flower beds and the birdbath, and it works up and down in stripes until every blade is cut. Then it stands back to admire the job, and the grass grows back in a new garden.

Drag the mower to drive it yourself, or hold the arrow keys (or W, A, S, D): it goes the way you point, cutting as it goes. Let go and it works out where it is and carries on with whatever is still long. Drive it over a flower bed and the old lady whose flowers they were comes out with her rolling pin; keep out of her reach until her stopwatch runs out.

Now and then a small garden gnome pops up near the mower, turns to face it and dances, jeering, then dives back into the grass and pops up again further on. Click him while he is up and he is stuck exactly where he stands; if the mower passes over him he breaks.

Mushrooms come up in rings, dandelions dot the lawn, and in places clover and crabgrass have woven themselves into the turf. The mower takes them all.

N (or New Garden) starts a fresh garden. E (or Engine) turns the mower's engine off and on; with it off the mower stands where it is. Mower switches between the orange, red and green machines. Sound and Music turn this game's sound and music off and on; M turns the music off and on. Space (or Pause) stops everything; a paused garden does no work. Q (or Detail) chooses how fine the picture is. With Reduced Motion on, nothing is thrown about by the mower.
